//строка подключения      
scaffold - dbcontext "server=localhost;database=wpf;trusted_connection=true;trustservercertificate=true;" microsoft.entityframeworkcore.sqlserver - outputdir models - force - dataannotations



//для бд
private static database instance;
public static database getinstance()
{
    if (instance == null)
    {
        instance = new database();
        instance.creators.load();
        instance.equipments.load();
        instance.orders.load();
        instance.points.load();
        instance.suppliers.load();
        instance.users.load();
    }
    return instance;
}



//mainwindow.xaml
<window x: class = "wpfapp1.mainwindow"
        xmlns = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns: x = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns: d = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns: mc = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        xmlns: local = "clr-namespace:wpfapp1"
        mc: ignorable = "d"
        title = "mainwindow" height = "500" width = "800" >

    <window.resources >
        <datatemplate x: key = "itemcardtemplate" >
            <local:usercontrol1 / >
        < / datatemplate >
    < / window.resources >

    <grid >
        <!-- пользователь и роль -->
        <textblock x:name = "fullnametext" margin = "0,10,72,0" textwrapping = "wrap"
                   textalignment = "right" horizontalalignment = "right" width = "330" height = "19" verticalalignment = "top" / >
        <textblock x: name = "roletext" margin = "579,408,10,0" textwrapping = "wrap"
                   verticalalignment = "top" textalignment = "right" / >

        <button x: name = "exitbutton" content = "выйти" margin = "0,10,10,0"
                verticalalignment = "top" click = "exitbutton_click" horizontalalignment = "right" width = "60" / >

        <!-- поиск-- >
        <textbox x: name = "searchbox" margin = "10,10,0,0" height = "25" verticalalignment = "top" horizontalalignment = "left" width = "120"
                 textchanged = "searchbox_textchanged" visibility = "hidden" / >

        <!-- производитель-- >
        <combobox x: name = "sortbymanufacturer" margin = "135,10,0,0" height = "25" verticalalignment = "top" horizontalalignment = "left" width = "162"
                  selectionchanged = "sortbymanufacturer_selectionchanged" visibility = "hidden" / >

        <!-- сортировка-- >
        <stackpanel orientation = "horizontal" margin = "310,10,0,0" horizontalalignment = "left" verticalalignment = "top" visibility = "hidden" >
            <radiobutton x: name = "downtoupradiobutton" content = "0-9" groupname = "sortprice" checked = "downtoupradiobutton_checked" visibility = "hidden" / >
            <radiobutton x: name = "uptodownradiobutton" content = "9-0" margin = "10,0,0,0" groupname = "sortprice" checked = "uptodownradiobutton_checked" / >
        < / stackpanel >

        <!-- кнопки-- >
        <stackpanel orientation = "horizontal" horizontalalignment = "left" verticalalignment = "bottom" margin = "10,0,0,10" visibility = "hidden" >
            <button x: name = "addbutton" content = "добавить" height = "25" margin = "0,0,10,0" visibility = "hidden" / >
            <button x: name = "editbutton" content = "редактировать" height = "25" margin = "0,0,10,0" visibility = "hidden" / >
            <button x: name = "deletebutton" content = "удалить" height = "25" visibility = "hidden" / >
        < / stackpanel >

        <!-- список карточек -->
        <listview x: name = "equipmentlist" margin = "10,45,10,50"
                  itemtemplate = "{staticresource itemcardtemplate}"
                  scrollviewer.verticalscrollbarvisibility = "auto" / >
    < / grid >
< / window >
